questions_and_answers.question_text: What does lìliang mean, and how is it translated in 7A?
What does the pattern jìn...lái mean?
Write the Chinese for "Unity is strength."
Write the Chinese for "In recent years, she has changed a great deal."

answers.answer_text: Jìn jǐnián lái, tā biànhuà hěn dà.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "The suitcase isn't heavy; it's light."
Write the Chinese for "No force can separate us."

answers.answer_text: Shénme lìliang yě bù néng bǎ wǒmen fēnkāi.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give the Chinese for "light industry" and "heavy industry."

articles.text:
7. A: Tīngshuō zhèige nóngyèqū       I hear that this agricultural area
      yǐjing yǒu lìliang fāzhǎn      already has the capability to develop
      gōngyè le.                     its industry.
   B: Jìn shínián lái, zhèige       Over the past ten years, agricultural
      dìqūde nóngyè shēngchǎn gǎode  production in this area has been good
      bú cuò, shōurù bù shǎo, gǎole  and income has been high, so some light
      yìdiǎnr qīng gōngyè.           industry was set up.

Notes on No. 7

-qū: "area," "region," "district." This word, which you have already seen in dìqū, "area," and kuàngqū, "mining region," can combine with many other words:

gōngyèqū      industrial region
nóngyèqū      agricultural region, farming region
shāngyèqū     business district (of a city)
fēngjǐngqū    scenic spot
shānqū        mountainous district

lìliang: "power," "force," "strength." In 7A this is translated idiomatically as "CAPABILITY." Another example: jīngjì lìliang, "economic capability."

Wǒmende lìliang bú gòu, méiyou   Our power is insufficient; there is no
bànfǎ bāngzhu ni.                way we can help you.
Tuánjié jiù shi lìliang.         Unity is strength.
Shénme lìliang yě bù néng bǎ     No force can separate us.
wǒmen fēnkāi.

jìn...lái: "DURING THE LAST..."

Jìn sāntiān lái, Xiǎo Huá        For the last three days, Xiǎo Huá has
hǎoxiàng xīnli hěn bù gāoxìng.   seemed very unhappy.
Jìn jǐnián lái, tā biànhuà hěn   In recent years, she has changed a great
dà.                              deal.
Jìn bǎinián láide Zhōngguó lìshǐ Chinese history of the past hundred
hěn yǒu yìsi.                    years is very interesting.

qīng: "to be light" in weight

Xiāngzi bú zhòng, hěn qīng.      The suitcase isn't heavy; it's light.
Qīng gōngyè gōngrén méiyou       Light industrial workers do not have as
zhòng gōngyè gōngrénde shōurù    high wages as heavy industrial workers.
duō.
